name: Block v2 with Height in Coinbase
summary: Requires the block height to be included in the coinbase transaction's input script, preventing duplicate coinbase transactions across different blocks. Also introduced block version 2.
summaryZh: 要求在 coinbase 交易的输入脚本中包含区块高度，防止不同区块之间出现重复的 coinbase 交易。同时引入了区块版本2。
